description: This file defines a mock class 'ControllerMock' for the 'IController' interface used in IPC (Inter-Process Communication) within the Rialto project. It uses Google Mock to facilitate unit testing by mocking the behavior of the IPC controller.

classes.name: ControllerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IController interface for testing purposes within the IPC module.

methods.description: Default constructor for the mock Controller class.

methods.description: Default destructor for the mock Controller class.

methods.description: Mock method to simulate resetting the controller state.
